app.title: EDGE//DASH
status.offline_hint: Is the service running? systemctl --user start edge-dashboard
theme.title: Theme
theme.help: Decides how the display looks. A new theme is a CSS file dropped into frontend/css/themes.
theme.language_help: Applies to the kiosk window. The language of this window is in the Language menu.
modules.title: Modules
modules.help: Each module produces the data for one or more widgets. A disabled module costs nothing.
modules.interval_help: How often the module measures. Leave empty for its default.
modules.secret_unchanged: Stored, type over it to change
weather.title: Weather
weather.help: Data comes from Open-Meteo, without an account or a key.
youtube.title: YouTube
youtube.help: One tile per entry. A video URL, an 11-character video ID or a playlist URL all work.
actions.title: Actions
actions.help: Tiles of the quick-action deck. A folder holds further tiles.
actions.label: Label
actions.command_help: One argument per line, no shell runs in between.
actions.secret_hidden: Hidden for safety and kept unchanged when you save.
layout.title: Layout
layout.help: Pages of the display. On the touchscreen you swipe between them.
layout.variant_help: Display variant handed to the widget. Leave empty for its default look.
layout.preview_help: Drag to move, the bottom-right corner resizes.
layout.delete_page_confirm: Delete page “{name}” with all its widgets?
layout.last_page: The last page cannot be deleted.
about.title: About
about.description: Settings for the Edge Dashboard on the Corsair Xeneon Edge.
system.title: System
system.help: Settings of this machine, not part of the dashboard configuration.
system.autostart_help: Starts the backend and the kiosk window automatically at the next login. It does not change anything about the session that is running right now.
system.units_missing: Not installed yet, created when you switch this on.
icons.load_failed: Icons could not be loaded. Is the backend running?
icons.emoji_failed: Emoji picker could not be loaded.
actions.more_pages: {count} tile(s) do not fit on this page and sit on {pages} further deck page(s).
status.starting_hint: The services are coming up, this takes a moment.
settings.weather.name: Location
actions.pick_tile: Pick a tile on the left to edit it.
about.deckswitch: A Stream Deck for the desktop: freely assignable keys for programs, commands and devices, built in the same spirit as this project.
